facts.text: Kid, you stay in the ship. Eat something. That's an order, and I mean it.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. Tony does not say this. The Tony Stark lines on the Moviemistakes page I opened (a partial list) include none about the ship or eating.
facts.fix: Kid, you stay in the ship. Eat something. That's an order, and I mean it.
